protocol.note: C59 account-list rebuild (2026-08-14): every instruction's account list was rebuilt from official IDLs. route/sharedAccountsRoute/exactOutRoute/sharedAccountsExactOutRoute/routeWithTokenLedger/sharedAccountsRouteWithTokenLedger/setTokenLedger/claimToken use tenequm/solana-idls idl/jupiter.json (the deployed-program IDL family, snake_case instruction names) - its user-first layouts (writable source/destination token accounts, signer authority, mints, token programs, fee, event authority) match live mainnet getTransaction jsonParsed structures. route_v2 (bb64facc31c4af14) and shared_accounts_route_v2 (d19853937cfed8e9) are grounded directly from live mainnet transactions (2026-08-14) plus the C22.3 pinned fixture (slot 438012579): user-first, source/destination token accounts writable, both token programs, platform fee, program. The remaining V2 variants use their V1 base layouts; the 8 *Check variants share their base instruction's account layout (the deployed program's simulation-check convention). GAPS (no authoritative source): accountCompressionRoute/sharedAccountsAccountCompressionRoute/exactOutAccountCompressionRoute/sharedAccountsExactOutAccountCompressionRoute (compression-route family) and closeTokenLedger keep their prior placeholder lists and remain fail-closed for swap intent (FakeSwap) - grounding requires the current compression-route IDL or live compressed-token traffic.
